title: Po Nagar
visualBrief: Specific Po Nagar standing complex: four mapped brick shrine envelopes with tall four-register main tower/miniature crowns, pointed south pyramid, smaller northwest stepped crown/saddle cap and low southeast saddle cap, projecting pointed entry porches/stone lintels/real recessed doors, original simplified relief/leaf/corner ornament and short local approaches. Mapped lower mandapa is an unroofed platform with approximate twenty octagonal tapered brick pillars and narrow grade-following approach steps. Existing shared brick/stone/dark-recess materials; no copied deity/story/text atlas, full ritual interior, vanished temple reconstruction or broad upper-court slab.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Original standard6m Mapzen hill/city ground and water retained. Each tower and occupied mandapa platform has its own local level top with grade-buried bottom; short tower approaches and narrow connecting stair/cheeks follow the sampled coarse native grade. Open upper courts stay native ground. No broad hill/precinct slab, flattening or ground/water cutout. Coarse DEM does not resolve actual paved terraces, stair thresholds or cliff/retaining faces. Its retained mandapa maximum sample is slightly above the main-tower floor, so the narrow approach follows coarse native grade rather than recreating the photographed steep descent. This level relationship remains a terrain-resolution limitation.
